situation: Ali's toy robot can walk and make sounds. He watched it closely for a month.
question: Is the toy robot a living thing?

statements.text: The robot did not grow bigger during the month.
Living things grow and reproduce. The robot does neither, so it is a non-living thing.
The toy robot is not a living thing.
The robot cannot make more robots on its own.

situation: Mei put two similar plants in pots. Plant A was placed near a sunny window. Plant B was kept in a dark cupboard. Both were watered every day for one week.
question: Do plants need sunlight to stay healthy?

statements.text: Plants use sunlight to make their own food through photosynthesis. Without sunlight, Plant B could not make food.
Plant B turned yellow and drooped.
Plants need sunlight to stay healthy.
Plant A stayed green and grew taller.

situation: Lily saw an animal in the park. It had a beak, two legs and its body was covered in feathers.
question: Which animal group does this animal belong to?

statements.text: Its body was covered in feathers.
The animal is a bird.
Feathers are the outer covering of birds. No other animal group has feathers.

situation: Ravi left one slice of bread in a warm, damp cupboard and another slice in the fridge for 5 days.
question: Does mould grow better on bread kept in a warm place?

statements.text: The bread in the fridge had no mould.
Mould grows better on bread kept in a warm place.
Mould is a fungus. It feeds on the bread and grows faster where it is warm and damp.
The bread in the warm cupboard had many patches of mould.

situation: Siti looked closely at her mug. The body of the mug is shiny and hard. The handle is light and smooth.
question: Is the mug made of more than one material?

statements.text: The handle of the mug is made of plastic.
An object can be made of one or more materials. The mug uses two different materials.
The body of the mug is made of metal.
The mug is made of more than one material.

situation: Jun dropped 5 drops of water onto a piece of cloth, a piece of paper and a plastic sheet.
question: Which material is best for making an umbrella?

statements.text: The cloth and the paper soaked up the water.
Plastic is the best material for making an umbrella.
The water stayed on top of the plastic sheet.
Plastic is waterproof because it does not absorb water, so it keeps us dry.

situation: Hana placed 10 green bean seeds on wet cotton wool and 10 green bean seeds on dry cotton wool. Both dishes were kept in the same warm place.
question: Do seeds need water to germinate?

statements.text: Seeds need water, oxygen and warmth to germinate. The seeds on dry cotton wool had no water.
The seeds on dry cotton wool did not germinate.
Seeds need water to germinate.
The seeds on wet cotton wool germinated after 3 days.

situation: Daniel watched mosquitoes in a container of water for two weeks.
question: How many stages are there in the life cycle of a mosquito?

statements.text: The larvae changed into pupae.
Animals that go through the egg, larva, pupa and adult stages have a 4-stage life cycle.
Eggs on the water hatched into larvae.
The mosquito has a 4-stage life cycle.
Adult mosquitoes came out of the pupae.

situation: Aisha brought a magnet near an iron nail and a copper coin.
question: Does a magnet attract all metals?

statements.text: The magnet did not attract the copper coin, even though copper is a metal.
Magnets only attract magnetic materials such as iron, steel, nickel and cobalt. Copper is not a magnetic material.
The magnet attracted the iron nail.
A magnet does not attract all metals.

situation: Ken made an electromagnet with an iron nail, a battery and wire. He counted how many paper clips it could pick up.
question: Does the number of turns of wire change the strength of an electromagnet?

statements.text: With 20 turns of wire, the electromagnet picked up 9 paper clips.
More turns of wire make an electromagnet stronger.
With 10 turns of wire, the electromagnet picked up 4 paper clips.
More turns of wire give the electromagnet a stronger magnetic force, so it can attract more paper clips.
